Alex —

Thanks again for taking the time today — really appreciated the candid discussion about your latency/cost goals and the usage patterns for document summarization and clinical notes. Quick recap and proposed next steps below: 

- What we heard: primary medium-term goal is to reduce per-inference cost for entity extraction while keeping P95 latency under 300ms; heavy tail of occasional long-sequence requests (3–4k tokens) from batch jobs.
- What Redwood can help with: model variant recommendations + quantization profiles, dedicated capacity for predictable throughput, and an exec-level alignment to confirm procurement and security needs.

Proposed next steps: 
1) Technical deep-dive demo (30–45m) where Connor will walk through live inference, batching, and KV cache examples — good for your engineering/ML lead.
2) Exec alignment (15–30m) — VP/CTO intro to ensure product/security stakeholders are aligned and unblock procurement.

Connor, I’ve cc'd you to lead the technical demo. Alex — are any of these times next week workable?

Happy to adjust — thanks and talk soon.
